title: Square crop and the Groq/local voice split
notes: File actions can center-crop an image to a square before converting or resizing.
Groq remains the default assistant and transcription provider; Local (Windows, offline) remains an explicit alternative.
Added regression coverage for the Groq default and the local option.

title: An offline speech option that needs no API key
notes: Dictation and recorded voice can use Local (Windows, offline). It uses the speech recognizer already installed in Windows; audio stays on this PC.
Local speech needs no provider key and no cloud-audio consent. Quality depends on the Windows speech language pack.
Cloud providers remain the default and are unchanged. Whisper/Parakeet model packs are still a separate optional download.

title: Keys leave with the app, lyrics hold still, and the agent gets a face
notes: Uninstall now removes saved API keys, integration secrets and the local agent token even when notes and history are kept.
Lyrics render only the current and previous full lines. The current line no longer restarts its slide for every word.
Settings > Appearance adds a customizable blob companion with shape, hue, expression and a click reaction.
All Tools adds File actions: drop or choose an image, inspect it, convert PNG/JPEG and resize to a new file.
The 0.19.0 PRD covers file editing, offline speech, and the Rune/Astryx evaluations.

title: Clearer lyrics, a quieter chat, and a notch that leaves
notes: Lyrics now show only the current line and the line before it. The current line is larger and bold; the previous line is smaller and faded. No third clipped row.
Chat opens without the “Ask a question” intro. The conversation and composer get the space instead.
The island closes after the pointer leaves, unless it is pinned or voice, capture, a task or a manual terminal session is active.
Settings > About now includes What’s new and the public release history.

title: Automatic updates are live
notes: Checks shortly after startup, every six hours and from Settings.
Downloads in the background, then offers Restart now or Later.
Installs only after the app exits and keeps settings, keys and local data.
Added the public release channel at agent-notch-releases.

title: Installer hand-off hardening
notes: The install helper is created through Windows Management Instrumentation so it survives the app process ending.
SQLite is checkpointed and closed before the installer runs.

title: Verified update test build
notes: Verified the installed 0.17.6 to 0.17.7 update path.
Kept the current updater and data-preservation behavior.

title: First updater-enabled build
notes: Added NSIS automatic updates with electron-updater.
Added Settings and tray update status.
